chapter_title: Concerning the Ad[vent] of the Apostle.
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by later layers: dialogue framing, apostolic-succession instruction, and extensive New Testament-derived narrative (Jesus, Judas, Paul, Paraclete sayings). The only recoverable correspondential/cosmological substrate appears as brief embedded summaries of mysteries (Depths/Heights; Light/Darkness; construction of the Ships; purification mechanics; Adam myth), preserved inside Mani-autobiographical revelation rhetoric.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Dialogue-frame setup: disciples questioning the Teacher about his apostolate; biographical/topic-introduction voice rather than cosmological exposition.
Explicit speech-attribution formula (“The apostle says…”), a compiling/community frame marker.
Second-person address (“O my beloved ones”) and analogy applied to apostles/churches in historical time; not cosmos→cosmos mapping but institutional/applied instruction.
Continuation of agricultural/merchant imagery to explain apostolic work; remains an applied analogy, not systematic cosmological architecture.
Institutional categories (Elect, catechumens) and ‘church-formation’ language; this is application to community structure (editorial/institutional extension).
Apostle/church-cycle instruction; ‘flesh’/‘greatness’ language serves the institutional narrative rather than presenting impersonal cosmological mechanisms.
Farmer-cycle simile continuing the apostolic succession teaching; applied discourse rather than substrate cosmology.
Apostles from the ‘moulding of humanity’ in a salvation-history frame; not a degree-structured cosmos→cosmos mapping.
Ecclesial succession and post-mortem help for the church; ‘support/leader/guardian’ roles are institutional-hagiographic rather than cosmological taxonomy.
Supportive analogies (farmer/merchant) reinforcing the apostolic-succession lesson; no substrate system exposition.
Tree/fruit propagation used to argue continuous revelation; applied ecclesiology (church/apostles) rather than cosmic correspondential registers.
Institutional cycle: another apostle sent as the former church ascends; despite ascent language, the subject remains church succession and salvation-history.
List of apostles across eras (Sethel…Buddha…Zarathustra…Jesus) is salvation-history/mission ideology, not impersonal cosmological teaching.
New-Testament vector: docetic Jesus language tied to apostolic preaching (Phil 2 echo) and Judas betrayal narrative; enters via Christian tradition.
Passion/resurrection sequence and Holy Spirit breathing are explicitly NT narrative material.
Continuation of the Jesus-apostles narrative frame; still part of the NT-derived overlay context.
Paul as apostle reinforcing others is NT-derived salvation-history.
‘Narrow’ vs ‘broad’ road motif is Gospel-derived moralizing; late overlay application.
Ecclesial decline and a ‘righteous man’ in the last church; institutional history rather than cosmic system exposition.
Metaphor of tree stripped of fruit applied to church-history; not cosmological mechanics.
Explicit Gospel saying about sending the Paraclete (Johannine citation/paraphrase) marks NT entry vector.
Paraclete speech paraphrases John 16 (upbraid concerning sin/righteousness/judgement); NT overlay.
Paraclete-of-truth salvation-history (“from Jesus until now”) continues the Johannine/Christian synthesis frame rather than an impersonal cosmic taxonomy.

paragraphs.removed_material: Removed Mani-autobiographical dating and royal chronology (“Artabanus… Ardashir… crowned”) and the revelation-scene framing (“the living Paraclete came down to me… spoke with me”), retaining only the impersonal list of cosmological mysteries (Depths/Heights; Light/Darkness; mingling and cosmic formation).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Embedded cosmological summary: impersonal ‘mystery of…’ catalogue focused on cosmic architecture (Depths/Heights; Light/Darkness; mingling; cosmic battle). It is preserved inside later autobiographical revelation rhetoric, suggesting reuse of an older catechetical kernel.

paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional/list extension beginning with “Also, the mystery of the apostles who were sent to the world…” through the Elect/catechumens commandments and the sinners/punishment material, because it shifts from cosmic mechanisms to church structure and discipline.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The opening items remain within Manichaean cosmic mechanics (Ships as purification apparatus; Light separation; abyss disposal; Adam’s fashioning). The latter half turns outward to institutional categories (Elect/catechumens), likely a later editorial graft extending a mystery-list.
Rhetorical self-testimony and ecstatic totalizing claim (“I have become a single body, with a single Spirit!”) belongs to hagiographic/self-authorizing revelation style, not substrate exposition.
Mission-travel autobiography (preaching, choosing an election) functions as apostolic vitae material.
Extended historical itinerary with kings and lands; biographical/mission frame.
Addresses ‘holy church’ and ‘good election’, claims superiority of Mani’s mission; institutional self-legitimation rather than cosmic system teaching.
Meta-textual remark about writing books and repeating a lesson ‘in brief’; editorial-authorial closure voice.
Formulaic closing: disciples rejoice, thank, and acclaim him as Paraclete; classic hagiographic closure.
